lines.text: God tells Ezekiel to prophesy against the forest of the Negev, where He will ignite a fire.
Ezekiel tells God that the people are saying he is just telling parables.
God tells Ezekiel to set his face against Babylon and prophesy that He will draw His sword.
Ezekiel is told to groan with a broken heart because of the news that is coming, when every knee will turn to water.
God appoints a sword at all their gates and says He will strike His thigh and satisfy His wrath.
